test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the information received till March 2022, who was the Leader of the House in the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Piyush Goyal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Piyush Goyal is a Bharatiya Janata Party politician and former Railway Minister of India and the Prime Minister of the Ministry of Coal, Government of India.**
 
• Union Minister Piyush Goyal has b**een appointed as the Leader of the House in the Rajya Sabha.**
 
• His appointment is effective from July 06, 2021.
 
• Shri Goel, a two-time Rajya Sabha MP, is currently the Deputy Leader of the NDA as well as a Union Minister in the Cabinet.
 
• He is serving as the Union Minister of Textiles, Minister of Commerce and Industry and Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Leader of the House of the Rajya Sabha is a member of the Rajya Sabha who is a cabinet minister or any other nominated minister.
 
• Rajya Sabha is the upper representative assembly of Indian democracy.
 
• **Lok Sabha is the lower House of Representatives. There are 245 members in the Rajya Sabha.**
 
• **In which 12 members are nominated by the President of India. These are called 'nominated members'.**
 
• Other members are elected. Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected for six years, of which one-third of the members retire every two years.
